bindings.resource_phrase: one valued resource or access right is concrete and identifiable: potable water in the illuminated desalination pipes feeding three community tanks
bindings.control_phrase: an existing controller or control system visibly owns current authority: the outgoing controller keeps one hand on the locked master console before relinquishing the brass key
bindings.claim_phrase: another adult claims receives or reroutes that control: the visibly adult woman receives the brass master key and turns it in the console's COMMAND socket
bindings.affected_phrase: an identifiable affected person depends on the same resource path: a storm-soaked clinic courier in a blue raincoat holds an empty emergency canteen beneath the community-tank outlet indicator
bindings.result_phrase: grant withholding blockage or rerouting visibly changes that access: her key turn sends the illuminated water route from HOLD to ACTIVE toward the courier's marked clinic tank
